reviews.x: Make sure to read instructions before you use.  Also when putting in the microwave,  I would suggest no more than minute or minute and half watch out don't get to hot can burn top of head.

reviews.t: Need more room for more hair
reviews.x: The cap does serve it purpose but I wish it was bigger. I generally use the microwave to heat it up and I do one minute or less. It holds heat very well make sure if it’s to hot rob the touch let it cool off a little before apply because the middle heats up well. It’s a good cap especially with you dot h  oh t a lots of hair but if it was bigger (more room) then I would be in love.

reviews.t: While It IS A Little Tight...
reviews.x: I have used this bonnet several times for deep conditioning my naturally curly hair.  Yes, I rinsed it in water and laid it on a towel to dry before first use. No big deal. I wrapped it in a towel and put it in the microwave for two to three 30-second blasts before using it the first time.  It worked like a dream.  Maybe I just have a big ol’ head, but that elastic band made me feel like it was trying to force the brains out of my head. I’m hoping the elastic will loosen up after some more use,

reviews.t: Great not to be connected to electricity by a cord.
reviews.x: My thin baby hair is in need of conditioning. This microwaveable cap is great and gets the job done.
Heavy and tight. 23in head here. Sent it back.

It's okay. Pretty much you get what you pay for. Personally wouldn't buy again. The gel had exploded when I got it. The replacement seems to be okay. But it's super uncomfortable and heavy. And to heat it up you can only do so in 30 sec increments without risking the gel exploding. In hind sight I wish I had just spent the money on a higher quality heat cap.

I brought this because the price was decent and my old cap's gel got deflated. Doesn't warm up like it did. The gel doesn't get deflated when I put it in the microwave so that's good. And the temperature is just right. I did noticed how I have to frequently put it in the microwave because it gets cold after a few minutes but I think all gel caps does that.

reviews.t: It burnt in the microwave. Less than 3 months of Purchasing it. Almost caught the microwave on fire
reviews.x: I put it in the microwave for less than the recommended three minutes. Less than 3 months of purchase the gel inside slowly melted and this morning it burnt and there's a big hole in the bonnet and the microwave almost caught on fire. I had it in there for less than 2 minutes

The cap is not as big as I expected. The example pic is NOT accurate or the model’s head is very small.  I have longer hair so I’m not sure if the fit will be comfortable. I may return it if it’s too tight or all my hair can’t fit.
The heat cap is amazing. The only con is that the band is a little to tight and the material of the band hurts against your skin. Regardless, the cap abtains great amou y of heat for a long time.

reviews.t: It caught on fire in my microwave!
reviews.x: I've had this cap for almost a year and we loved it until today! The instructions say 2 minutes in the microwave. It started lighting up after 1 minute!
First time attempting to use this heat cap it leaked, followed the instructions and everything.
So easy to use, it’s very comfortable. I love it. Definitely value for money.
Nice cap, soft. Wishes heat lasted longer

Had this cap for just under a year, great concept- cordless heat cap for deep conditioning. Held the heat for 15-20 mins, I’d reheat it again in the microwave and wear an additional 15-20 mins. Size of cap was ok, bit tight and got uncomfortable if I wore it any longer than 40 mins. I usually continue with house chores and let it do it’s thing. Only negative is that  it seem to lose the gel/ heating element and I had to discontinue using it. Not sure how that happened but it was worth it based o

The first time I used this I soaked it for almost 20 minutes.  I heated it for 60 seconds, then 30 seconds increments and it worked ok.  The second time I tried to use doing the same thing, it didn't work.  It burst and the gel started leaking, it has become flat. I am a week and a half outside of my window of being able to return for a refund.  Now it's just money lost.

This heat cap didn’t even fit on my head. I wouldn’t recommend this whether you have short or long hair. The band that is supposed to go around your head isn’t flexible at all.  I bought this to put on top of my treatment, but even when I try to force the heat cap on, it doesn’t budge. The head circumference on this product was most likely made for children?

The band is really tight which makes it hard to put on and take off. The filling is gel which I personally do not care for. This was my first trying a gel heat cap and this will be my last. The outside and inside lining of the cap is hard, I'm guessing to contain the gel which makes it uncomfortable to wear. I couldn't lay my head down at all.

I followed the instructions in its entirety to avoid damaging the product. During my first use of the Yebeauty cap I noticed it was leaking a gel like substance and from there it never stopped. Also, I was expecting the cap to hold the heat for at least 30 mins but nope...not so efficient.Poor poor value for money

The elastic is very tight. I have tried to give it time but still painfully tight after 5 uses. There is not a lot of gel on top so I feel like there is in even heating. I did follow the initial directions. It gets too hot after microwaving and it cools way too fast; it seems to be only about 15 mins of heat.

reviews.t: Should have listed to the other reviewers
reviews.x: I read so many times that it was too tight, but I was buying this for my 4 year old daughter who has a small head. It was still way too tight! She won't let me use it on her at all, and it's heavy so letting it sit on her head for 30 mins during deep conditioning would have been a problem anyway.

I had to return both of them the first 1 thought it had ashes on it I rubbed it then I decided to smell it ITWAS MOLDED I have severe allergies I had a reaction I returned it then I got a replacement in which I didn't ask for I sent it straight back in opened  they are molded unsafe  to use..

I will upload a pic when I return home, but this cap was amazing. I placed it in hot water for about 5 min, dried it of, and microwaved for about 2 minutes. This cap remained hot for almost 35-45 minutes. My hair benefited greatly from this product! Thanks!

I bought one for myself and one for my mom. Mine was leaking the package when I opened it. My mom’s started leaking after one use. It’s too much of a pain to get my money back for hers so money straight down the drain. #nothappy

reviews.t: Ill stick to steaming my hair with a steamer
reviews.x: I use this to deep condition. The elastic part is uncomfortable, the liquid material comes out & got on my hair which wasnt hard to get out but I followed the instructions so the clear liquid thats inside shouldnt have came out

claims.text: Many reviewers find the cap too small or tight, especially those with longer or thicker hair.
Several reviewers report overheating problems, including burning, melting gel, or the cap catching fire in the microwave.
Some reviewers describe the cap as heavy and uncomfortable to wear.
Reviewers praise the cordless, microwaveable design for effectively delivering heat during deep conditioning.
A few reviewers report quality issues such as leaking gel or the product failing within about a year.
